text.en: Some literature is not only for enjoyment but also teaches how to live.

Yasodhara Kaviyam is one of the five minor Tamil epics (ஐஞ்சிறுகாப்பியங்கள்). The lesson says that literature does not only delight but also teaches ways of life, beginning with Thirukkural and many works on virtue.
It teaches non-violence and compassion towards all living beings, as taught in Jain tradition. It is among the memorisation poems.
Terms: ஐஞ்சிறுகாப்பியம் (five minor epics), அறம் (virtue), அகிம்சை (non-violence) and காவியம்.
